title: Clickable-surface styling crashes App startup
impact: Every normal App startup reaches MainWindowBuilder.build(), which unconditionally styles web_access_lbl. tkinter widgets implement __getitem__ but not __contains__, so the membership expression probes a numeric configuration key and raises TypeError before the main window finishes building.
fix: Detect foreground support without membership iteration, for example by checking widget.keys() or by applying fg only to widget classes/options known to support it, and add a Tk-backed regression test that calls style_clickable_surface on both a Label and a Frame.

evidence.detail: The new helper added this membership expression and MainWindowBuilder now calls the helper unconditionally while constructing the main window.
Runtime introspection confirmed tkinter.Widget has no __contains__; its inherited __getitem__ is cget, so membership falls back to numeric indexing and raises instead of returning a boolean.
UI-PRES-08 requires clickable styling to work on App click targets; this failure prevents the App surface from starting.

snippet: The Web Cockpit combines a filtered dashboard with a small allowlist of Bomana semantic controls. It runs independently from port 8111, never synthesizes keys, and keeps LAN sessions view-only unless control is explicitly enabled for the current run and the device pairs again.
title: English README misstates the new LAN control grant
impact: An English-reading user can enable LAN believing paired devices remain view-only, while the implemented one-action flow grants fixed-function control to later LAN pairings. The public security posture therefore understates the authority exposed on the LAN path.
fix: Update the English Web Cockpit summary to state that enabling LAN also enables control for later pairings and that disabling LAN immediately invalidates all LAN sessions.

evidence.detail: The adjacent Chinese README bullet was updated to the unified LAN action, but this English paragraph retained the previous two-step view-only model.
WDB-20 through WDB-22 define one-action LAN control grant and immediate full LAN-session revocation.
WebDashboardRuntime.enable_lan now enables LAN control authority after exact listeners bind; there is no separate App or tray control-enable action.
